entities.name: Query HldE-like protein
observations: The 482-residue sequence has estimated molecular mass 53.68 kDa, theoretical pI 5.10, negative charge at pH 7, and instability index 27.4.
Pfam scanning identifies an N-terminal PfkB domain (PF00294, residues 13-310) and a C-terminal CTP_transfer-like domain (PF01467, residues 350-474).
Closest curated homologs are bifunctional HldE proteins with about 47% identity, 97-99% query coverage, and E-values around 1e-132.

entities.name: HldE
observations: Curated homologs are bifunctional enzymes in ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose biosynthesis.
The two annotated activities are heptose-7-phosphate kinase activity (EC 2.7.1.167) and heptose-1-phosphate adenylyltransferase activity (EC 2.7.7.70).
Curated homologs are annotated as cytosolic and homodimeric, with ATP binding.

entities.name: ADP-heptose biosynthesis
observations: HldE catalyzes steps 1 and 3 in the pathway producing ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose from heptose-7-phosphate and heptose-1-phosphate intermediates.

entities.name: Heptose-7-phosphate phosphorylation
observations: D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate + ATP yields D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose 1,7-bisphosphate + ADP; Rhea RHEA:27473.

entities.name: Heptose-1-phosphate adenylyltransfer
observations: D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose 1-phosphate + ATP yields ADP-D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose + diphosphate; Rhea RHEA:27465.
